claim: Desktop app to extract pages, split, merge, mix and rotate PDF files
Open source under the AGPL since version 3; earlier versions are GPLv2
Version 4 and later ships self-contained with a bundled jlinked JDK; version 3 required Java Runtime Environment 8 with JavaFX
Documentation, FAQ and a wiki page listing properties and arguments exist
README lists only extract, split, merge, mix and rotate; no text editing, OCR or signing is described
Multi-platform desktop software written in JavaFX
